source.paraphrase: The RPC URL comes from the environment and is never hardcoded or committed.

invariants.why: The public endpoint rate-limits and falls over, usually in the middle of the demo. Static syntax cannot prove values or provenance across helpers and imports; see BACKLOG.md for this rule's uncaught flow and warning default.
invariants.fixHint: Read the RPC URL from .env.local (one Triton key per team) and never commit it.
invariants.avoid: A committed .env.local, or a fallback constant that points back at the public endpoint.

source.paraphrase: Hackathon code runs on devnet unless the task says mainnet.

invariants.why: Nobody deploys to mainnet in a hackathon; a mainnet default burns real SOL and demo time. Static syntax cannot prove values or provenance across helpers and imports; see BACKLOG.md for this rule's uncaught flow and warning default.
invariants.fixHint: Default to devnet. Touch mainnet only when explicitly asked.
invariants.avoid: A flag that defaults to mainnet with a comment saying it should be devnet.
